native.solo: Both thinking and automatic-next timers freeze while an annotated image is open, then resume; the oral activity stays ungraded. A failed image also closes the editor and allows the clock to continue.

geometry: Four tools and four colours; maximum 48 strokes per image and 160 integer points per stroke in a 0–1000 frame. Original media bytes are unchanged.
sourceIdentity: Annotations follow original image indexes when scenes are reordered; repeated pictures remain separate positions.
persistence: Incremental add/undo/clear events and compacted checkpoints; deep copying and strict validation; stale screen and attempt rejected; no image bytes, temporary blob URLs or private model in annotation data.
teacherAuthority: Pause and lock forbid edits. Enlarged viewing remains available with lock. Console progression and audio suspend during annotation. Oral activities retain human assessment.
offline: Editor code is part of the already loaded components; no extra chunk is fetched on the first offline enlargement after full preparation.

checks.lint: passed with existing warnings and no new warnings in annotation files
checks.secrets: Gitleaks 8.30.1 passed with no findings in its documented change scope; scanner rules unchanged.

remaining: Physical ENI and phone tests; cold offline start; remote annotation synchronization; predictions only when an explicit verified source question exists.
